prompt:
Use case: precise original diffuse texture edit. Image1 is the ONLY complete original game UV texture, nearest enlarged from its native size. Preserve the exact whole canvas aspect and every original painted island/boundary, count and phase, source material identity, native physical pattern scale, and subdued relative palette. Refine existing low-resolution painted shading into fine HD matte painted transitions at4x; retain weak folds/marks as weak washes. Output the same complete flat UV atlas, not a rendered garment, scene or newly designed object. Fine irregular painted grain can refine existing grain without new regular weave, hatching, quilting, embroidery, scratches, photographic pores/leather, bevels, brightspecular lights or ornamental patterns. No new dots/hardware, new dark seams, changes to anatomy, glyphs/labels/badges/letters or new objects. No cropping/padding/BBox/registration/recentering/border/letterbox. Keep original dim shading strength: do not turn washed darkareas into sharply outlined mechanical parts. Preserve full source canvas including alpha-positive RGBblack painted fields; blackRGB alone never means transparentcutout.
Native256x128, complete2:1 canvas enlarged nearest8x2048x1024; finalwholecanvas1024x512. Sourcealpha255 everywhere, including2032 blackwashed/background areas; do not cut out blackregions. Keep two dim darkbrown maincloth fields native[30,0,105,128) and[105,7,170,128), narrow farleftbrown strip[0,0,29,128), and right bluegray softcloth[170,7,256,128) in the exact source colors. Exactly5 pale SOURCEpaint groups: two tiny left markers at[40,36,42,37) and[40,52,42,53), two uppermiddle markers at[156,12,157,13) and[156,18,157,19), and one weak farleft wash at[12,73,13,75). The fifth is faintwash within an existing longangular painted contour, not another button: retain its dim source nature. Keep the original small muted zigwash[40,69,53,101) and soft lower bootwash[57,103,104,128), their source outlines and turns without newly resolvedlaces/eyelets/stitching. All flat/dim brown gradients stay matte andlowcontrast, bluecloth preserves softexistingfolds withoutnewweave or sharpcreasegeometry.
